violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. Observed a can of tomato sauce stored on the floor in the kitchen.
Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was reused or used more than one time. A carboard box is being used as a trash can.
Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder or bar soap.
